notes.title: 📢 Achievement Bug Fixes Update! 🏆
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve been listening to your feedback and have been working hard to fix issues related to our achievements. 🎯

With this latest update, achievement-related bugs have been resolved, ensuring that your progress is properly tracked and rewarded. Thank you to everyone who reported these issues and helped us improve the game!

If you encounter any further problems, feel free to let us know. Happy hunting for those achievements! 🏅

notes.title: 📢 Korean Language Re-Enabled! 🇰🇷
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re happy to announce that the Korean language is now fully available again! 🎉

We previously encountered some issues displaying Korean characters, but we’ve worked hard to resolve them, and now everything should be working as intended.

Thank you for your patience and support! If you notice any issues, feel free to let us know. We hope our Korean players enjoy the game to the fullest!

Happy gaming! 🎮

notes.title: 📢 New Update! Improved Asian Translations 🌏
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've just released a new update focused on improving the quality of translations for several Asian languages. Thanks to community feedback, we've fixed localization errors and enhanced the overall consistency of in-game text.

🔹 What's included in this update?
✅ Fixed translation issues for [specific languages: Chinese, Japanese, etc.].
✅ Adjusted fonts and formatting for better readability.
✅ Improved consistency across all localized text.

We appreciate your support and feedback! If you spot any remaining translation issues, feel free to let us know.

🔧 Thank you for playing!

notes.title: City of Nightmares Release on Feb 04, 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080685/7863f1809d954967797f28371a1921dff3c1885a.png[/img]

We're glad to announce
[h2][b]City of Nightmares is coming on February 4, 2025![/b][/h2]

Step into a haunting mystery as you explore a hotel abandoned after a deadly virus outbreak. Uncover secrets hidden within a ghostly hotel, solve puzzles, and face restless spirits in a journey that blurs the line between the living and the supernatural.

 [h3][b]🕵️‍♂️ Investigate the Mystery[/b][/h3]
Explore the forsaken hotel, collect evidence, and piece together the events that led to the demise of its inhabitants.

[h3]👻 [b]Encounter Ghostly Presences[/b][/h3]
Face supernatural entities and experience paranormal events as you delve deeper into the haunted hotel's secrets.

[h3]🗓️ [b]Release Date: February 4, 2025[/b][/h3]
Available on Steam.

[b]Add to your wishlist[/b] and prepare to uncover the truth!
